description: The Mazda CX-80 is a mid-size crossover SUV with three-row seating produced by the Japanese automaker Mazda since 2024. Based on the shorter, five-seater CX-60, the CX-80 is the fourth vehicle to use Mazda's rear- and all-wheel drive with longitudinal engine layout categorized as Large Product Group, with same powertrains found in the CX-60 including a plug-in hybrid.
